name: Horizon: Tests Built for Future Models
description: Five difficulty ladders that today's best models cannot finish: running programs in your head, 44-digit arithmetic, provably shortest sliding-puzzle plans, 35x35 logic pictures and exact domino-tiling counts. Each test has ten frozen levels, each strictly harder than the last, so a model measured years from now climbs exactly the same ladder. The score is the share of the ladder climbed; the headline is the highest level solved reliably. Every answer is checked by machine against a key proven by two independent solvers. Long replies: budget roughly $15-25 per frontier model per repeat.
